title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 114 (Westcan Terminals)
heading: Westcan Terminals
sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Westcan Terminals
114 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 1-4 in the vicinity of Cowichan Bay being the area within 25 metres on either side of the midline of Westcan Terminals Road commencing at the easterly boundary of Indian Reserve #9 and proceeding easterly along the said road to its end and including the area 25 metres seaward from the paved edge of the Westcan Terminals Ltd. port site. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 12.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
